blocked.name: Chancellor of the Annex

blocked.name: Gemstone Caverns
blocked.why: Begins on the battlefield only if you're not the starting player, with a luck counter, exiling a card from your hand.

blocked.name: Braid of Fire

blocked.why: The upkeep cost puts a +1/+1 counter on an opponent's creature per age counter.

blocked.name: Thought Lash
blocked.why: Upkeep cost exiles the top card per age counter, and 'when a player doesn't pay' exiles their library.

blocked.name: Topography Tracker
blocked.why: 'If a creature you control would explore, instead it explores, then explores again': no explore replacement.

blocked.name: Market Gnome
